title: Designer Tribute Zine + Poster
summary: An eight-page tribute to designer Jonathan Castro, translating his layered visual energy into a zine and reverse-side quote poster.

hero.alt: Looping preview of the tribute zine.

overview.challenge: A project researching a contemporary artist and designing a publication inspired by their style. I chose Jonathan Castro for his vibrant colors, chaotic compositions, and the way he draws inspiration from his Latin culture.
overview.solution: I built an image-driven visual system with layered textures, distortion, repetition, and shifts in scale to echo Castro’s energetic approach while retaining my own authorship.
overview.outcome: The final folded zine prioritizes rhythm and immersion over conventional hierarchy, with a quote poster on the reverse: ‘Design is the accumulation of energy in an object.’
overview._notes: Copy refined to reflect the documented project concept.

blocks.label: 01 — Research
blocks.body: I chose Jonathan Castro because I was drawn to his vibrant colors, chaotic compositions, and the way he draws inspiration from his Latin culture—something I deeply connect with as well.
blocks.heading: Studying Jonathan Castro’s visual language

blocks.label: 02 — Sketches
blocks.heading: Finding the right kind of chaos
blocks.body: The early layouts tested how far the imagery and type could be pushed while keeping the publication readable. I explored layered compositions, changes in scale, and repeated elements, then refined the pacing across the folded eight-page format.

blocks.label: 03 — Concept development
blocks.alt: Concept development for the zine and poster.
blocks.heading: From research to an immersive zine
blocks.body: Rather than copying individual visuals, I translated the energy behind Castro’s work into a system of image manipulation, texture, repetition, and contrast. The poster extends the publication’s idea outward, using a concise quote as its central message.

blocks.label: 04 — Final
blocks.caption: Reverse-side quote poster: ‘Design is the accumulation of energy in an object.’
